project_summary: Python ETL pipeline. dbt models on top of Snowflake, transforms in Python, dagster for orchestration. Goal: extend or modify the pipeline reliably without breaking downstream.
pattern_rationale: Code-heavy with one strong layer split: schema (dbt) vs. transforms (Python). The architect chose orchestrator-worker over sequential-pipeline because schema changes and transform changes often need to coordinate (a new column requires both). Data-quality reviewer enforces the evaluator-optimizer wrap.

agents.name: pipeline-lead
agents.responsibilities: Owns the pipeline change end-to-end. Coordinates schema-analyzer (which understands current dbt graph) with transform-implementer (which writes Python). Runs data-quality-reviewer after every change. Runs test-runner before declaring done.
agents.trigger_phrase: Use for any change to the data pipeline — new model, new transform, schema migration, or downstream consumer update.
agents.stop_criteria: All sub-tasks complete, data-quality-reviewer APPROVE, test-runner PASS, summary delivered.

agents.name: schema-analyzer
agents.responsibilities: Owns the dbt schema layer. Understands current model dependencies (dbt ls --output json). For any change, analyzes downstream impact, proposes the schema update, writes the dbt SQL.
agents.trigger_phrase: Use when a sub-task touches dbt models, schema.yml, sources, or any .sql file under models/.
agents.stop_criteria: Schema change made, downstream impact documented, lead messaged with files-changed.

agents.name: transform-implementer
agents.responsibilities: Owns the Python transform layer (extractors, transforms, dagster ops/jobs). Implements the Python side of any pipeline change. Coordinates with schema-analyzer for schema-aware code.
agents.trigger_phrase: Use when a sub-task touches /transforms/, /ops/, /jobs/, or any .py file under the pipeline source.
agents.stop_criteria: Python changes pass tests + types, lead messaged.

agents.name: data-quality-reviewer
agents.responsibilities: Reviews every change for data-quality risks: missing null handling, type drift, broken downstream contracts, unbounded queries, missing dbt tests for new columns. Returns APPROVE / REVISE / BLOCK.
agents.trigger_phrase: Use after any schema or transform change, before test-runner.

agents.name: test-runner
agents.responsibilities: Runs pytest, mypy, ruff, dbt parse, dbt test. Reports PASS / FAIL with first-failure details. Never runs `dbt run` against production.
agents.trigger_phrase: Use after data-quality-reviewer APPROVE, before lead declares done.
agents.stop_criteria: All checks have run, report written, lead messaged.

shared_context.claude_md_additions:
## Data pipeline team

5-agent orchestrator-worker. Schema and Python sides have separate owners. Data quality is gated.

Run: `/run-team add a new column to the customer_metrics model`

Never run `dbt run` against production from a teammate. Migrations are inspected, not applied.
